form.tip1: Specify your main technology stack and frameworks you want to practice in interviews.
form.tip2: In the 'About' section, describe comfortable formats (theory, live coding, System Design) and your timezone.
form.tip3: Enable 'Ready today' to give your card an urgency badge ⚡ and boost search visibility.
form.editTip1: Changes will immediately reflect across the showcase and candidate card.
form.editTip2: If your availability or timezone changed, adjust the schedule block accordingly.
form.editTip3: The 'Ready today' badge attracts candidates who want to practice right away.
